question: 'My Country My Life' is an autobiography of __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**LK Advani**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **LK Advani** is the author of the autobiography **"My Country My Life."**
 
• LK Advani is a prominent Indian politician and a founding member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• He has served as the Deputy Prime Minister of India from 2002 to 2004.
 
• "My Country My Life" provides a detailed account of his political journey and the evolution of Indian politics over the decades.
 
• The book covers significant events in Indian politics, including the Emergency period, the Ram Janmabhoomi movement, and the rise of the BJP.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lal Krishna Advani** was born on November 8, 1927, in Karachi, which is now in Pakistan.
 
• He started his political career with the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) and later joined the Bharatiya Jana Sangh, the precursor to the BJP.
 
• Advani has been a Member of Parliament for several terms and has held various key positions within the BJP and the Indian government.
 
• He is considered one of the most influential leaders in the history of Indian politics and has played a crucial role in shaping the BJP's ideology and strategy.
 
• His autobiography, "My Country My Life," was published in 2008 and has been widely read and reviewed.
